hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools implementing VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) fees. Calculates fees as e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ]-1 using an off-chain ECDSA-signed toxic velocity parameter (σ); every swap must supply a valid SignedSigma in hookData. Fees are captured via BeforeSwapDelta and forwarded to a YieldDistributor for share holders.
